project.name: imglab
project.currentFocus: DermaScope facial skin analysis flow using one face photo, backend OpenCV-Python overlay generation, category scores, and zone breakdowns.
durableFacts: ImgLab MVP is scoped to real image processing methods: restoration, enhancement, edge/threshold tools, upscaling, and optional morphology.
Architecture is a browser-first single page app using React + Vite + Tailwind CSS + DaisyUI, with optional OpenCV.js and FastAPI backend.
Optional backend is FastAPI plus OpenCV-Python, exposing health, goals, and process endpoints.
MVP excludes Wiener filter, inpainting, ESRGAN/Real-ESRGAN, accounts, server-side image storage, batch processing, and persistent project history.
Current implementation uses the React frontend in frontend/ with backend /api processing.
The active product direction is DermaScope: upload one face photo, analyze skin-condition signals, show an overlay, category scores, Skin Health Score, and zone breakdown.
Backend analysis estimates acne, dark spots, wrinkles, redness, and pores with classical OpenCV heuristics.
The app remains database-free and does not persist uploaded image files.
Production deployment is now a monolith: one FastAPI container serves both /api routes and the built React frontend.

lastAchievements: Replaced the previous general ImgLab workbench scope with the DermaScope facial skin analysis concept.
Redesigned the React UI around a face overlay stage, Skin Health Score, condition score stack, and zone breakdown.
Added backend facial skin analysis overlay generation with face detection fallback, skin mask, condition masks, and structured analysis metadata.
Created required docs: project brief, ADR, flow overview, API/public contract, database/data model, design contract, and design intent.
Implemented static ImgLab MVP with upload, OpenCV.js operation registry, processing, compare slider, reset, and PNG export.
Added package.json, package-lock.json, static server, and operation contract test.
Reworked UI from raw method selection to goal-based selection and removed decorative line/grid backgrounds.
Added optional Python FastAPI backend scaffold with goal-based upload processing and frontend backend-mode switch.
Deferred OpenCV.js loading until the first process action to reduce initial UI freezes.
Shifted frontend copy, package metadata, README, and design docs from ImgLab workbench framing to DermaScope skin-analysis framing.
Updated operation contract tests for the single skin-health analysis goal.
Added production monolith Dockerfile and converted compose.prod.yaml to a single app service on port 8080.
Added upload/camera source switching in the frontend intake flow.
Improved overlay readability with distinct condition marker shapes and short labels drawn into the image.
